blocks.zh: 第二章：人員管理
blocks.en: Chapter 2: Personnel

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 GDP（Good Distribution Practice，優良配銷規範）對人員能力與數量的基本要求
blocks.en: Understand the basic GDP (Good Distribution Practice) requirements for personnel competence and numbers

blocks.zh: 掌握「指定責任人（Designated Responsible Person）」的法規定位、12 項核心責任，以及「可授權任務但不可授權責任」的原則
blocks.en: Master the regulatory position of the Designated Responsible Person, the 12 core responsibilities, and the principle that duties may be delegated but responsibilities may not

blocks.zh: 了解 GDP 訓練計畫的要素：初始訓練、持續訓練、特殊產品訓練，以及訓練有效性評估
blocks.en: Understand the elements of a GDP training programme: initial training, continuing training, training for special products, and assessment of training effectiveness

blocks.zh: 認識人員衛生管理在配銷環境中的基本要求
blocks.en: Recognise the basic requirements for personnel hygiene in the distribution environment

blocks.zh: 能將本章要求對應至 CDMO 倉儲作業的實際人員管理實踐
blocks.en: Be able to map the requirements of this chapter to actual personnel management practices in CDMO warehouse operations

blocks.zh: 2.1 — Principle / 原則
blocks.en: 2.1 Principle

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「人」是 GDP 的關鍵
blocks.en: Key concept: people are the key to GDP

blocks.zh: GDP Principle 的第一句話就直接點明：藥品的正確配銷，靠的是人（relies upon people）。這與 GMP 的製程設計優先邏輯不同——在配銷端，人員的判斷力、責任心與能力，直接決定了整個供應鏈的品質完整性。
blocks.en: The very first sentence of the GDP Principle makes the point directly: the correct distribution of medicinal products relies upon people. This differs from the process-design-first logic of GMP. At the distribution end, the judgement, sense of responsibility and competence of personnel directly determine the quality integrity of the entire supply chain.

blocks.zh: 「能力（Competence）」在法規語境中包含三個維度：
blocks.en: In a regulatory context, "competence" has three dimensions:

blocks.zh: 知識（Knowledge）： 了解 GDP 要求與產品特性
blocks.en: Knowledge: understanding GDP requirements and product characteristics

blocks.zh: 技能（Skill）： 能正確執行作業程序
blocks.en: Skill: being able to carry out procedures correctly

blocks.zh: 態度（Attitude）： 對品質合規的承諾與警覺性
blocks.en: Attitude: commitment to quality and compliance, and vigilance

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一個物流倉庫就像一支棒球隊：
blocks.en: Imagine a logistics warehouse as a baseball team:

blocks.zh: 球員人數不夠 → 場上必然漏洞百出（人員數量不足）
blocks.en: Too few players: the field is bound to be full of gaps (insufficient personnel numbers)

blocks.zh: 球員不清楚自己打什麼位置 → 球滾過來沒人接（責任不明確）
blocks.en: Players do not know which position they play: the ball rolls through and nobody fields it (unclear responsibilities)

blocks.zh: 每個球員都知道自己的守備範圍 → 才能流暢協作（責任已記錄）
blocks.en: Every player knows their own area of defence: only then can the team work together smoothly (responsibilities are recorded)

blocks.zh: GDP 要求的「責任被清楚理解且被記錄」，本質上就是確保沒有任何配銷作業處於「無人負責」的狀態。
blocks.en: GDP's requirement that responsibilities be "clearly understood and recorded" essentially ensures that no distribution activity is left with nobody in charge.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 「記錄（recorded）」的法規意涵： 口頭分配責任在 GDP 稽查中是不被接受的。職務說明書（Job Description）、組織圖（Organisation Chart）、授權矩陣（Authorisation Matrix）等書面文件，是審計員驗證人員責任是否明確的主要證據。
blocks.en: The regulatory meaning of "recorded": Verbal assignment of responsibilities is not acceptable in a GDP inspection. Written documents such as job descriptions, organisation charts and authorisation matrices are the main evidence auditors use to verify that personnel responsibilities are clear.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 倉儲部門因人員流動，目前有 2 個職位空缺，GDP 對此情況有何要求？
blocks.en: If a CDMO warehouse department currently has 2 vacant positions because of staff turnover, what does GDP require in this situation?

blocks.zh: 「能力」與「訓練完成」是等號嗎？如何在 GDP 框架下證明一名新進倉管員已具備執行任務的能力？
blocks.en: Is "competence" the same as "training completed"? Under the GDP framework, how can you demonstrate that a new warehouse operator is competent to perform the tasks?

blocks.zh: 2.2 — General / 通則
blocks.en: 2.2 General

blocks.zh: 核心概念：組織架構的三層文件要求
blocks.en: Key concept: three layers of documentation for the organisational structure

blocks.zh: GDP 2.2 對組織管理要求了三個層次的文件化：
blocks.en: GDP 2.2 requires documentation of organisation management at three levels:

blocks.zh: 組織圖（Organisation Chart）： 宏觀層次，顯示各部門和職位的隸屬關係與橫向互動
blocks.en: Organisation chart: the macro level, showing the reporting lines and lateral interactions between departments and positions

blocks.zh: 職務說明書（Job Description）： 個人層次，明確列出特定職位的職責範圍與決策權
blocks.en: Job description: the individual level, clearly listing the scope of responsibilities and decision-making authority of a specific position

blocks.zh: 代理安排（Deputising Arrangements）： 連續性層次，確保關鍵職位在人員缺席時不會造成作業空白
blocks.en: Deputising arrangements: the continuity level, ensuring that key positions do not leave a gap in operations when the post-holder is absent

blocks.zh: 人員配置 vs. 業務量的關係，類似餐廳的排班邏輯：午餐尖峰需要 5 個服務員，但半夜打烊前 1 個就夠。GDP 沒有給出固定人數，而是要求廠商根據「作業量（volume）與範圍（scope）」自行評估。稽查員在審核時，會比對你的日均訂單量、倉儲面積、特殊產品比例與實際在職人數，判斷配置是否合理。
blocks.en: The relationship between staffing and workload is similar to restaurant shift scheduling: the lunch peak needs 5 servers, but 1 is enough just before closing at night. GDP gives no fixed headcount; instead it requires the company to assess for itself based on the "volume" and "scope" of activities. During an audit, inspectors compare your average daily order volume, warehouse area, proportion of special products and actual headcount to judge whether staffing is reasonable.

blocks.zh: 代理安排（Deputising）特別重要： GDP 明確要求在職務說明書中記載代理安排。這在實務上意味著，當倉儲主管出差或休假時，必須有明確指定的代理人，且該代理人必須具備足夠的能力執行關鍵任務（如放行判定、異常處理）。若稽查期間關鍵人員恰好缺席而無明確代理人，這本身就是一個觀察缺失（Observation）。
blocks.en: Deputising arrangements are particularly important: GDP explicitly requires deputising arrangements to be recorded in the job description. In practice, this means that when the warehouse manager is on a business trip or on leave, a clearly designated deputy must be in place, and that deputy must be competent enough to carry out critical tasks (such as release decisions and deviation handling). If a key person happens to be absent during an inspection with no clearly designated deputy, this in itself is an observation.

blocks.zh: 你們公司的組織圖最後一次更新是什麼時候？GDP 對組織圖的更新頻率有具體要求嗎？
blocks.en: When was your company's organisation chart last updated? Does GDP set a specific update frequency for organisation charts?

blocks.zh: 負責冷鏈產品接收的倉管員職務說明書，應比一般常溫倉管員的說明書多涵蓋哪些內容？
blocks.en: What additional content should the job description of a warehouse operator responsible for receiving cold chain products cover compared with that of an ambient-temperature warehouse operator?

blocks.zh: 2.3 — Designation of Responsibilities / 責任指定
blocks.en: 2.3 Designation of Responsibilities

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「指定責任人（Designated Responsible Person）」的法規地位
blocks.en: Key concept: the regulatory status of the Designated Responsible Person

blocks.zh: GDP 中的「Designated Responsible Person」（縮寫 DRP，指定責任人）在法規地位上，相當於 GMP 環境中的「合格人（Qualified Person, QP）」——是整個配銷品質體系的法律責任核心。
blocks.en: In regulatory standing, the "Designated Responsible Person" (DRP) in GDP is equivalent to the "Qualified Person (QP)" in the GMP environment: the legal and responsibility core of the entire distribution quality system.

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：可以授權任務（duties），但不能授權責任（responsibilities）。
blocks.en: Key principle: duties may be delegated, but responsibilities may not.

blocks.zh: 實務意義：DRP 可以指派倉管員執行溫度記錄，但當溫度超出規格時，「如何判定產品最終處置」的責任仍在 DRP 身上，不能因為任務已授權給他人而免責。
blocks.en: Practical meaning: the DRP can assign a warehouse operator to carry out temperature recording, but when the temperature goes out of specification, the responsibility for deciding the final disposition of the product remains with the DRP. The DRP is not relieved of responsibility because the task has been delegated to someone else.

blocks.zh: DRP 的角色就像一家醫院的院長（CEO）：
blocks.en: The DRP's role is like that of the CEO of a hospital:

blocks.zh: 院長可以委託各科主任管理科室日常（授權任務）
blocks.en: The CEO can entrust department heads with the day-to-day management of their departments (delegation of duties)

blocks.zh: 但當發生醫療事故時，院長仍是最終責任人（責任不可轉移）
blocks.en: But when a medical incident occurs, the CEO remains ultimately accountable (responsibility cannot be transferred)

blocks.zh: 必須 24 小時可聯繫（out of hours contact）
blocks.en: Must be contactable 24 hours a day (out of hours contact)

blocks.zh: 需要足夠的資源與授權才能真正履行職責
blocks.en: Needs adequate resources and authority to genuinely fulfil the role

blocks.zh: 注意 2.3.3 的要求：公司必須給予 DRP「確定的授權（defined authority）」和「足夠資源（adequate resources）」。若 DRP 有名無實，法規稽查員會認為這是系統性缺失。
blocks.en: Note the requirement of 2.3.3: the company must give the DRP "defined authority" and "adequate resources". If the DRP exists in name only, regulatory inspectors will regard this as a systemic deficiency.

blocks.zh: 「非上班時間聯絡（Out of Hours Contact）」： GDP 明確要求廠商指定人員負責緊急及召回的非上班時間聯絡。這在實務上代表需要建立 On-Call 輪值制度，並將緊急聯絡清單（包含手機號碼）列入 SOP，且保持最新狀態。稽查員會要求查看這份清單並確認其時效性。
blocks.en: "Out of Hours Contact": GDP explicitly requires the company to designate a person responsible for out-of-hours contact for emergencies and recalls. In practice, this means establishing an on-call rota, and including an emergency contact list (with mobile phone numbers) in an SOP and keeping it up to date. Inspectors will ask to see this list and confirm that it is current.

blocks.zh: 退貨重新入庫（Returns to Saleable Stock）是高風險環節： 第 xi 項責任特別重要。退貨產品在重新進入可銷售庫存前，必須由 DRP 評估並核准，評估依據應包含儲存條件確認、外觀檢查、Cold Chain 完整性等（詳見 GDP Chapter 7）。
blocks.en: Returns to saleable stock is a high-risk step: Responsibility xi is particularly important. Before returned products re-enter saleable stock, they must be assessed and approved by the DRP, and the assessment should include confirmation of storage conditions, visual inspection, cold chain integrity and so on (see GDP Chapter 7 for details).

blocks.zh: 若公司的 DRP 同時兼任品保主管與倉儲主管，稽查員可能提出什麼潛在的利益衝突問題？
blocks.en: If the company's DRP also serves as head of quality assurance and head of warehousing, what potential conflict-of-interest questions might an inspector raise?

blocks.zh: 一批冷藏產品（2-8°C）客戶退回時，DRP 需要確認哪些資訊才能決定是否可以重新入庫銷售？
blocks.en: When a batch of refrigerated product (2-8°C) is returned by a customer, what information does the DRP need to confirm before deciding whether it can be returned to saleable stock?

blocks.zh: 「核准供應商資格」（第 vi 項）在 CDMO 的情境下，通常包含哪些評估面向？
blocks.en: In the CDMO context, what assessment aspects does "approving suppliers" (responsibility vi) usually include?

blocks.zh: 2.4 — Training / 訓練
blocks.en: 2.4 Training

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GDP 訓練的三個層次
blocks.en: Key concept: three layers of GDP training

blocks.zh: GDP 2.4 建立了一個三層訓練架構：
blocks.en: GDP 2.4 establishes a three-layer training structure:

blocks.zh: 基礎層（適用所有人）： GDP 法規要求認知、偽藥識別
blocks.en: Foundation layer (applies to everyone): awareness of GDP requirements and identification of falsified medicines

blocks.zh: 角色層（依職位訂制）： 初始訓練 + 持續訓練，依據書面 SOP 和書面訓練計畫執行
blocks.en: Role layer (tailored to the position): initial training plus continuing training, carried out according to written SOPs and a written training programme

blocks.zh: 特殊產品層（依產品特性）： 冷鏈、毒品管制藥品、放射性物質等的專項訓練
blocks.en: Special product layer (according to product characteristics): specific training for cold chain, narcotic and controlled drugs, radioactive materials and so on

blocks.zh: 注意 2.4.1 的時序要求：「在開始執行任務之前（prior to commencing their tasks）」必須具備能力與經驗。這意味著新進員工的試用期訓練必須在正式承擔 GDP 關鍵作業前完成，不能邊學邊做。
blocks.en: Note the timing requirement of 2.4.1: competence and experience must be in place "prior to commencing their tasks". This means that training for new employees during the probationary period must be completed before they take on GDP-critical activities; they cannot learn on the job while performing those activities.

blocks.zh: 訓練有效性評估（Effectiveness Assessment）就像學生的考試：
blocks.en: Assessment of training effectiveness is like a student's examination:

blocks.zh: 老師教過了（訓練已執行）≠ 學生學會了（能力已確立）
blocks.en: The teacher has taught (training has been delivered) does not equal the student has learned (competence has been established)

blocks.zh: GDP 要求你不只要有「訓練簽到表」，還要有「評估結果」——測驗成績、實作考核、觀察記錄等
blocks.en: GDP requires not only a "training attendance sheet" but also "assessment results": test scores, practical assessments, observation records and so on

blocks.zh: 若評估發現訓練無效，還需要記錄後續的補強措施
blocks.en: If the assessment finds the training ineffective, the follow-up remedial actions must also be recorded

blocks.zh: 稽查員最常問的問題之一：「你如何知道訓練是有效的？」——光靠簽到表是無法回答的。
blocks.en: One of the questions inspectors ask most often: "How do you know the training is effective?" An attendance sheet alone cannot answer it.

blocks.zh: 偽藥識別訓練（Falsified Medicines）是強制要求： 2.4.3 明確點名偽藥識別訓練。這與歐盟《偽藥指令》（Falsified Medicines Directive, FMD）的背景相關。在實務上，倉管員必須能識別可疑產品的特徵（包裝異常、序號無法驗證、來源不明等），並知道如何啟動異常處理程序。
blocks.en: Training in identifying falsified medicines is mandatory: 2.4.3 explicitly names training on the identification of falsified medicines. This is linked to the background of the EU Falsified Medicines Directive (FMD). In practice, warehouse operators must be able to recognise the characteristics of suspect products (abnormal packaging, serial numbers that cannot be verified, unknown origin and so on) and know how to initiate the abnormal-event handling procedure.

blocks.zh: DRP 也需要持續訓練： 2.4.2 明確要求 DRP 也要透過定期訓練維持 GDP 能力。這意味著 DRP 不能只做一次 GDP 訓練後就永久免訓——法規更新、SOP 修訂後，DRP 也需要重新訓練並留存記錄。
blocks.en: The DRP also needs continuing training: 2.4.2 explicitly requires the DRP to maintain GDP competence through regular training. This means the DRP cannot take GDP training once and then be exempt from training permanently. After regulatory updates and SOP revisions, the DRP also needs to be retrained, and records must be kept.

blocks.zh: 特殊產品訓練在 CDMO 情境的重要性： 若 CDMO 同時處理常溫、冷藏（2-8°C）及冷凍（-20°C 或 -80°C）產品，各溫區操作人員需要接受對應的冷鏈特定訓練，訓練記錄必須與溫度要求掛鉤。
blocks.en: The importance of special product training in a CDMO setting: If a CDMO handles ambient, refrigerated (2-8°C) and frozen (-20°C or -80°C) products at the same time, operators in each temperature zone need cold chain training specific to that zone, and training records must be linked to the temperature requirements.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 情境： 你們公司新增了一條 -80°C 超低溫冷凍產品的配銷業務。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your company has added a distribution business for ultra-low-temperature (-80°C) frozen products.

blocks.zh: 依據 GDP 2.4，需要為哪些職位規劃哪些訓練模組？
blocks.en: Under GDP 2.4, which training modules need to be planned for which positions?

blocks.zh: 如何設計訓練有效性評估（什麼是合格標準）？
blocks.en: How would you design the training effectiveness assessment (what are the pass criteria)?

blocks.zh: 若倉管員的訓練評估未通過，下一步應如何記錄與處理？
blocks.en: If a warehouse operator fails the training assessment, how should the next steps be recorded and handled?

blocks.zh: 2.5 — Hygiene / 衛生
blocks.en: 2.5 Hygiene

blocks.zh: 核心概念：配銷環境的衛生要求
blocks.en: Key concept: hygiene requirements in the distribution environment

blocks.zh: GDP 2.5 的衛生要求相對精簡，但要求是「適當的（appropriate）」且與「所執行的活動相關（relevant to the activities）」。這意味著衛生標準應依照實際作業環境訂定：
blocks.en: The hygiene requirements of GDP 2.5 are relatively concise, but they must be "appropriate" and "relevant to the activities" being performed. This means hygiene standards should be set according to the actual operating environment:

blocks.zh: 健康（Health）： 傳染病、皮膚病等影響產品完整性的健康狀況管理
blocks.en: Health: management of health conditions, such as infectious diseases and skin conditions, that affect product integrity

blocks.zh: 衛生（Hygiene）： 手部衛生、個人清潔等基本要求
blocks.en: Hygiene: basic requirements such as hand hygiene and personal cleanliness

blocks.zh: 服裝（Clothing）： 工作服的規格、更換頻率、清洗管理
blocks.en: Clothing: specification of work clothing, frequency of changing, and laundering control

blocks.zh: 配銷環境（倉庫）的衛生要求雖然比製造潔淨室寬鬆，但仍必須防止污染風險，尤其是在開封包裝或處理破損品時。
blocks.en: Although the hygiene requirements of a distribution environment (warehouse) are less strict than those of a manufacturing cleanroom, contamination risk must still be prevented, especially when opening packaging or handling damaged goods.

blocks.zh: 配銷倉庫的衛生管理，類似超市生鮮區的員工管理：
blocks.en: Hygiene management in a distribution warehouse is similar to staff management in a supermarket's fresh food section:

blocks.zh: 員工有傷口或傳染病需要回報並暫時調離（健康管理）
blocks.en: Employees with wounds or infectious diseases must report them and be temporarily reassigned (health management)

blocks.zh: 處理生鮮食品前必須洗手（衛生程序）
blocks.en: Hands must be washed before handling fresh food (hygiene procedures)

blocks.zh: 穿著規定的工作服，不得在工作區域飲食（服裝與行為規範）
blocks.en: Wear the prescribed work clothing, and do not eat or drink in the work area (clothing and behaviour rules)

blocks.zh: 藥品比生鮮食品有更高的品質要求，衛生程序的文件化與執行紀律相應更為嚴格。
blocks.en: Medicinal products carry higher quality requirements than fresh food, so the documentation and enforcement discipline of hygiene procedures are correspondingly stricter.

blocks.zh: 「程序應被建立且被遵守（established and observed）」： 這兩個動詞同等重要。稽查員不只查 SOP 是否存在，還會透過現場觀察、訓練記錄和不符合記錄來驗證 SOP 是否被實際遵守。一份沒有人遵守的衛生 SOP，在法規上比沒有 SOP 更糟糕（因為代表系統性管控失效）。
blocks.en: "Procedures should be established and observed": These two verbs are equally important. Inspectors do not only check whether an SOP exists; they also verify through on-site observation, training records and non-conformance records whether the SOP is actually followed. From a regulatory standpoint, a hygiene SOP that nobody follows is worse than having no SOP, because it indicates a systemic failure of control.

blocks.zh: 衛生 SOP 的實用範圍： 應包含緊急情況下的處理（例如：倉管員在作業途中受傷出血時的處置程序，以及對可能接觸到血液的藥品包裝的隔離與評估）。
blocks.en: Practical scope of hygiene SOPs: They should include the handling of emergencies (for example, the procedure when a warehouse operator is injured and bleeding during work, and the segregation and assessment of medicinal product packaging that may have come into contact with blood).

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 倉儲環境中，衛生 SOP 應至少涵蓋哪些具體情境？請列舉三項。
blocks.en: In a CDMO warehouse environment, what specific situations should a hygiene SOP cover at a minimum? List three.

blocks.zh: 若一名倉管員在作業中發現自己接觸了可能受污染的表面，現有的衛生程序如何引導他/她的下一步動作？
blocks.en: If a warehouse operator finds during work that they have touched a possibly contaminated surface, how does the existing hygiene procedure guide their next actions?

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 人員是 GDP 的核心： 配銷品質最終由人的能力與責任心決定，法規要求所有人員具備能力，且責任必須被明確記錄
blocks.en: People are the core of GDP: Distribution quality is ultimately determined by people's competence and sense of responsibility. The regulation requires all personnel to be competent, and responsibilities must be clearly recorded

blocks.zh: 組織架構文件化： 組織圖 + 職務說明書（含代理安排）是 GDP 稽查的基本文件要求
blocks.en: Documented organisational structure: The organisation chart plus job descriptions (including deputising arrangements) are the basic documentation requirements in a GDP inspection

blocks.zh: 指定責任人（DRP）承擔 12 項核心責任，可授權任務但不可授權責任，且必須具備 24 小時緊急聯絡機制
blocks.en: The Designated Responsible Person (DRP) bears 12 core responsibilities; duties may be delegated but responsibilities may not, and a 24-hour emergency contact arrangement is required

blocks.zh: 訓練三層架構： 基礎 GDP 知識（含偽藥識別）→ 角色訂制訓練 → 特殊產品訓練（冷鏈、管制藥品等）；訓練有效性必須被評估並記錄
blocks.en: Three-layer training structure: basic GDP knowledge (including identification of falsified medicines) → role-specific training → special product training (cold chain, controlled drugs and so on); training effectiveness must be assessed and recorded

blocks.zh: 衛生程序覆蓋健康、衛生、服裝三個面向，必須被建立且被實際遵守，稽查員會現場驗證
blocks.en: Hygiene procedures cover three aspects: health, hygiene and clothing; they must be established and actually followed, and inspectors will verify this on site
